context_pill: Capital Gains Exemption on Amalgamation Share Swap
example_summary: M exchanged 2000 shares in ABC Ltd for 1000 shares in an amalgamated Indian company with ₹ 50,000 excess market value; AO's attempt to tax it is invalid under Section 47(vii).
source_provision:
### Statutory Matrix: Amalgamation Share Exchange | Statutory Provision | Subject / Subject Matter | Statutory Condition / Qualification | Legal & Tax Consequence | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Section 47(vii)** | Transfer of shares in Amalgamating Company | 1. Allotment of shares in Amalgamated Company
2. Amalgamated Company is an **Indian Company** | Excluded from definition of Transfer; **No Capital Gains Tax** | | **Section 49(2)** | Cost of Acquisition of new shares | Asset acquired pursuant to Section 47(vii) exchange | Deemed equal to **Cost of Acquisition** of old shares | | **Section 2(42A)** | Period of Holding of new shares | Explanation 1(i)(c) tacking rule | Includes **Period of Holding** of shares in Amalgamating Company | #### Core Statutory Conditions u/s 47(vii) * **Consideration Test:** Transfer must be solely in consideration of the allotment of shares in the amalgamated company. * **Jurisdictional Benchmark:** The resulting amalgamated entity **must be an Indian Company**. > [!NOTE] Capital Gain Benchmark: Not a Taxable Exchange > Although share allotment structurally resembles an exchange u/s 2(47), Section 47(vii) overrides general provisions. Any differential market value at allotment does NOT trigger Capital Gains.

director.justification: Section 47(vii) overrides general exchange treatment under Section 2(47) by exempting amalgamation share swaps from capital gains tax.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Introduce M's share exchange of 2000 shares in ABC Ltd for 1000 shares in the amalgamated company with ₹ 50,000 excess value and AO's tax proposal.
Evaluate statutory exemption conditions under Section 47(vii) requiring the amalgamated entity to be an Indian company.
Refute AO's attempt to tax the ₹ 50,000 differential Fair Market Value as capital gains on exchange.
Detail Section 49(2) cost substitution and Section 2(42A) period of holding tacking rules for future computation.
Summarize that the Assessing Officer's proposal is not justified and no immediate capital gains tax arises.
